description: Look up FDA drug labeling (package inserts / SPL documents). Check indications, warnings, dosage, contraindications, active ingredients, or any structured label section. A label runs to tens of thousands of tokens, so a page that exceeds the inline budget returns the list of available sections instead; re-call with sections to pull the ones you need.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page, with no skip and the same search, sort, and endpoint as that call; other inputs may change.

limit.description: Labels per page. A sections selection costs its size summed across every label on the page, so lower this before widening one. Default 5; a larger value returns at most 1000 and says so.

search.description: Label query, e.g. openfda.brand_name:"aspirin", openfda.generic_name:"metformin", openfda.manufacturer_name:"pfizer". set_id with an SPL UUID from earlier results fetches that product's label, in its current revision only (openFDA serves no earlier ones). A brand search also matches repackagers' copies: to keep the original packager's label, add AND openfda.is_original_packager:true (several or none can remain), or take identity.spl_set_id from openfda_drug_profile. A "+" between clauses reads as a space; inside a quoted phrase it is a literal plus.

sections.description: Label sections to return, e.g. ["boxed_warning","indications_and_usage"], named by an oversized page's outline or by openfda_describe_fields. Omitted or [], the whole label comes back, or its outline when the page exceeds the inline size budget; a selection comes back whole even over that budget. Metadata (openfda, set_id, id, effective_time, version) always comes back and counts toward the size.

skip.description: Records to skip, at most 25000; to read past that, follow next_cursor from skip 0.

sort.description: A field path with :asc or :desc (any letter case; :ascending and :descending also work), several comma-separated, e.g. effective_time:desc. A search without sort returns openFDA's index order, not relevance.

name: openfda_get_drug_label

cap.description: The limit applied to this page.

effectiveQuery.description: Search filter applied to the drug label query, as submitted to openFDA

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `rate_limited`: The openFDA daily or per-minute request limit is exceeded. `upstream_error`: The openFDA API returned a 5xx server error. `malformed_search`: search leaves a double quote, parenthesis, or range bracket unclosed, ends on a backslash, or holds a character openFDA refuses. `query_error`: The search query was rejected by openFDA (malformed field name, invalid syntax). `pagination_limit_reached`: skip exceeds the 25000 record pagination ceiling. `invalid_cursor`: cursor does not decode, belongs to another endpoint, search, or sort, or comes with skip above 0, stage, or canvas_id. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

kind.description: Whether this response carries label records ("full") or only the section outline of a page too large to inline ("outline").

limit.description: Page size applied: limit, the endpoint default, or the cap when limit exceeded it. The last page of a match holds fewer records.

totalUnverified.description: True on an empty page at skip > 0 whose total could not be confirmed: total 0 then does not rule out records — re-call with skip=0.

next_cursor.description: Pass as cursor for the next page; present on a page read at skip 0 or by cursor when more records follow.

notice.description: Guidance for this page: empty result, paging on and the original packager's label, the sized re-call for an outline, section names no record carried, a selection over the inline budget, limit clamp, end of a cursor walk. Absent when nothing needs saying.

outline.description: When kind is "outline": the sections on the page and their serialized size summed across it, largest first; pass names back in sections.

items.description: One retrievable label section and its serialized size.

bytes.description: Serialized byte size of the section

name.description: Section identifier — pass in `sections` to retrieve it

page_labels.description: The label records this page holds, in page order. Present when kind is "outline", which otherwise names no record.

items.description: One label record on the page.

bytes.description: This label's serialized UTF-8 size; one over 24000 bytes returns an outline even when re-called alone.

is_original_packager.description: True when openFDA flags the label as the original packager's, false for a label with an openfda block but no flag (a repackager's or relabeler's), null when the openfda block is empty — which nulls the three names too.

set_id.description: SPL set ID, the key to re-call this label alone.

results.description: Label records when kind is "full": an openfda block (brand_name, generic_name, manufacturer_name, route) plus the SPL sections each label has, such as indications_and_usage, warnings, dosage_and_administration, contraindications, adverse_reactions; with sections, only those plus metadata. _table sections carry raw SPL table markup as openFDA returns it; the text output renders them as Markdown tables.

shown.description: Number of labels returned in this response.

totalResults.description: Total matching label records in the dataset

truncated.description: True when more labels matched than this page returned — page with next_cursor or skip for the rest.

title: Openfda Get Drug Label
